designs.title: New Arrival Sneaker
designs.desc: Neon-lime light beams cut across a black set. The tracked-out headline interlocks with the shoe, so product and type share one plane and the lime swoosh ties back to the beams.
designs.alt: Social ad: black and blue running shoe on a dark plinth with neon lime light beams and the headline New Arrival Sneaker

designs.title: Action Camera Launch
designs.desc: A red-lit hero shot on a glass plinth, with a stacked ACTION CAMERA headline and spec callouts for the sensor, horizon lock and built-in mics.
designs.alt: Social ad: action camera with red glow on a dark plinth, feature callouts and a fast charging badge

designs.title: Wireless Headset
designs.desc: A monochrome studio set: a spotlit plinth, a ghosted HEADSET wordmark and frosted-glass chips for fast charging, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
designs.alt: Social ad: black over-ear headphones floating above a spotlit plinth in a monochrome scene

designs.title: EMO Pet Robot
designs.desc: The palette is taken from the robot’s own cyan eyes. The product name is set as a giant backlit wordmark behind it, under a playful “Your pet robot” line.
designs.alt: Social ad: small desktop pet robot with glowing cyan eyes in front of a large backlit EMO wordmark

designs.title: Cool Water Fragrance
designs.desc: Cold blue light, a condensation-beaded bottle and glass cubes carry the “cool water” idea. A vertical glass chip promises 20-hour wear.
designs.alt: Social ad: blue fragrance bottle with water droplets on glass cubes under cold blue light

designs.title: Footwear Fashion
designs.desc: Soft coral pleats and frosted-glass badges for 100% cotton and 10% off. A lighter, lifestyle-led retail post for a knit trainer.
designs.alt: Social ad: pink knit trainer on a white plinth against coral pleated backdrop with 10% off badge

designs.title: Mega Burger Package
designs.desc: A yellow-to-orange ground, splash photography of the drink and a red starburst for 10% off. Built to sell a combo deal at a glance.
designs.alt: Social ad: burger and splashing cola in front of a bold MEGA BURGER headline with a 10% off starburst
